subject: APC
source_sentence: the objective of Autoregressive Predictive Coding (APC) is to use the context to infer a future frame xt+n that is n steps ahead of xt.
title: Improved Speech Representations with Multi-Target Autoregressive Predictive Coding

subject: APC
source_sentence: APC incorporates an RNN to process each frame xt sequentially and update its hidden state ht accordingly.
title: Improved Speech Representations with Multi-Target Autoregressive Predictive Coding

subject: APC
source_sentence: When n = 1, one can view APC as an acoustic version of neural LM (NLM) by thinking of each acoustic frame as a token embedding, as they both use a recurrent encoder and aim to predict information about the future.
title: Improved Speech Representations with Multi-Target Autoregressive Predictive Coding

subject: APC
source_sentence: Once an APC model is trained, given an utterance (x1, x2,..., xN), we follow Chung et al. (2019) and take the output of the last RNN layer (h1, h2,..., hN) as its extracted features.
title: Improved Speech Representations with Multi-Target Autoregressive Predictive Coding

subject: APC

title: Improved Speech Representations with Multi-Target Autoregressive Predictive Coding
